messages:
irene (sec-eng): heads-up, CI flagged audit-event-validator failing intermittently on master :grimacing:
ci-bot: build #7214 failed — audit-validation-step (exit code 1) :x:
irene (sec-eng): failing assertion is in golden fixture diff for `user.key.rotate` events, payload order and `kms_key_id` formatting differ across runs
alex (eng-infra): hmm, last deploy included the RBAC payload cleanup. any chance we changed field ordering or introduced optional fields? :thinking_face:
sam (eng-ml): also rolled a tiny KMS client lib bump yesterday — it switched to returning `keyId` instead of `kms_key_id` in some codepaths (should have been normalized at the API boundary)
maya (qa): reproducer I ran locally shows the golden fixture contains "kms_key_id": "projects/..." but validator saw "keyId": "projects/..." and a random `trace_id` ordering change. test harness doesn't freeze UUIDs/timestamps currently
irene (sec-eng): can we quickly triage whether this is: (1) real schema regression, (2) flaky test (time/uuid), or (3) legit production change we need to accept?
alex (eng-infra): running the validator locally now: `./tools/audit-validate --fixtures test/golden/*.json --schema schemas/audit-v2.json`
alex (eng-infra): output: `FAIL: test/golden/user-key-rotate.json — missing property: kms_key_id`
alex (eng-infra): schema is v2, validators expect `kms_key_id`. so KMS client returning `keyId` is the mismatch source
sam (eng-ml): that explains it. the KMS bump introduced camelCase, but we upstreamed a serializer change that should've normalized — looks like we missed a codepath for audit events
maya (qa): workaround for CI: normalize keys before comparing, e.g. run `jq 'walk(if type=="object"then with_entries(.key |= ascii_downcase) else . end)'` on both actual/golden — but that's risky long-term
irene (sec-eng): agree—temporary CI patch OK but we need a proper fix. action items: (a) patch audit event serialization to canonicalize KMS field to `kms_key_id`, (b) add deterministic test harness that freezes UUIDs/times, (c) add regression test to CI to catch camelCase drift
alex (eng-infra): creating PR to normalize serializer + add a migration shim in validator to accept `keyId` for one release window — will link PR in a sec :arrow_down:
alex (eng-infra): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1842 — includes `serialize.audit.normalize_kms_id` and a validator acceptance rule
irene (sec-eng): thanks. maya can you add a small replay test where we feed the KMS client v1 and v2 payloads to the validator in CI matrix? we want to catch client upgrades
maya (qa): yeah will add matrix row and also update fixture generation script to `--freeze-time --seed 1234` so diffs are stable
ci-bot: build #7215 queued after PR merges — audit-validation-step will run with updated fixtures :rocket:
deploy-bot: note: deploying infra patch to staging tonight at 02:00 UTC — rollback window 30m
sam (eng-ml): one more note — we should version the audit schema (v2 -> v3) and add a changelog entry for KMS field normalization so customers aren't surprised
irene (sec-eng): good call. add to PR: schema bump + migration docs in compliance repo
alex (eng-infra): marking issue: https://issues.internal/RED-SEC-512 (audit fixtures CI flake due to KMS id camelCase)
irene (sec-eng): final: temporary CI normalization merged, serializer fix in codebase, QA added deterministic fixtures, and follow-up to version schema and update customer-facing docs. we'll monitor for two releases and then remove acceptance shim
maya (qa): monitoring job added to nightly CI to run the golden-fixture suite with both serializers for 7 days :eyes:
irene (sec-eng): thanks team, closing the triage thread — ping here if flakes reappear :thumbsup:
